# Quiz

> Property-based testing for Hoon. A frozen legacy library (`lib/quiz.hoon`)
> and generator, plus an Urbit Gall application: `%quiz` runs property
> documents and existing Clay `test-*` suites as bounded, replayable jobs, and
> `%quiz-web` serves a browser workbench at `/apps/quiz/`. Targets
> `[%zuse 408]`. Random checks are evidence, not proof. Each user call has a
> `%jinx` CPU limit; there is no memory isolation.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): installation, quick start, library-only use
- [User's guide](desk/doc/users-guide.md): seven-step tutorial, property-design advice, blog corrections
- [Reference](desk/doc/reference.md): public contracts, limits, outcomes, troubleshooting
- [Limitations](desk/doc/limitations.md): safety boundaries, unsupported behavior, operational caveats
- [Examples catalog](desk/doc/examples.md): bundled examples with recorded results

## Contracts

- [Property documents](desk/doc/source-format.md): `++fate`, `++norn`, `++alts`, `++conf`, restricted Ford prelude
- [Suites and replay](desk/doc/suites-and-replay.md): `test-*` discovery, aggregation, replay inputs
- [Agent API](desk/doc/agent-api.md): `%quiz-action` pokes, `%quiz-update` facts, scries
- [HTTP API](desk/doc/http-api.md): routes, authentication, JSON shapes
- [Workbench](desk/doc/workbench.md): explorer, documents, run controls
- [Keyboard shortcuts](desk/doc/keyboard-shortcuts.md)
- [Public types](desk/sur/quiz-app.hoon): request, record, outcome, state
